name: Summit AZ - Drafts Folder Overview
body:
> Log · Summit Az · 2026-05-30

# Summary
Late May 2026 working folder for city-page drafts and FAQ schema scripts, one subfolder per service line.

# Draft notes
- [Summit AZ - Drafts - General Plumbing Update Packs](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-general-plumbing-update-packs) (10 cities)
- [Summit AZ - Drafts - Drain Cleaning Fountain Hills](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-drain-cleaning-fountain-hills)
- [Summit AZ - Drafts - Water Heaters Queen Creek](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-water-heaters-queen-creek)
- [Summit AZ - Drafts - Leak Detection Scottsdale](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-leak-detection-scottsdale)
- [Summit AZ - Drafts - Water Softener City Pages](lib:brain-summit-az-drafts-water-softener-city-pages) (5 cities)

# Schema scripts (2026-05-30)
Every service subfolder (drain cleaning, emergency plumbing, fixture installation, garbage disposals, pipe lining, sewer line repair, tankless, water heaters, water leak detection, water pressure, water softeners) has an `_apply_schema.php` that writes `_summit_faqs_cache` post meta for the 10 city pages of that service, so the `summit-location-seo` mu-plugin outputs FAQPage schema. FAQ answers are templated per city with neighborhoods and local issues. The emergency set included 24/7, after-hours and flat-rate wording that was later removed from the visible pages (Sep 2026), so that cache may be out of sync with visible copy; check before relying on it.
